description: This source file defines the MotionService class which implements motion-related functionalities such as activity recognition and pedometer data retrieval using CoreMotion framework. It provides asynchronous methods to fetch and process motion data, applying authorization checks and data formatting.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: Final class providing motion data services such as activities and pedometer statistics, utilizing CoreMotion's APIs with async/await pattern.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches user activity data over a specified time range, returning a payload with activity entries.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Retrieves pedometer data such as steps and distance for a specified time interval.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Converts ISO8601 string parameters into Date objects defining start and end of the data range.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum to a readable string.
